def transform(grid):
    # Each isolated marker is replaced by the embedded five-cell pattern,
    # whose central source cell identifies the placement center.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pattern = None
    for row in grid:
        for j in range(len(row)-4):
            if row[j:j+5] == [7,7,5,7,5]:
                pattern = row[j:j+5]
                break
        if pattern: break
    if pattern is None: return out
    marker = 6 if any(6 in r for r in grid) else 7
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v == marker:
                # pattern appears around marker with its first cell two cells left
                for k,c in enumerate(pattern):
                    if 0 <= j-2+k < len(row): out[i][j-2+k] = c
    return out
PY
